title: CSS foundation coverage and implementation program

activation.foundation_rule: Required CSS/default-presentation dependencies of F09–F13 remain HTML foundation blockers; the later broad CSS program does not defer them.
activation.product_rule: A product milestone requires its explicit dependency closure and actual journey evidence. Unrelated printing, speech, Houdini and forward items are not blanket prerequisites for YouTube. A whole-CSS claim is not permitted while required applicable coverage remains open.
activation.preparatory_work: Independent syntax/selector/property corrections may land before F14 when they require no unfinished HTML/XHTML contract and preserve its implementation order. Each records its own baseline, dated clauses, original cases and finite evidence; full program and package acceptance remain gated.

implementation_slices.name: Selector comment boundaries
implemented: Stylesheet and native query selectors consume comments between tokens without introducing descendant whitespace or joining identifier/hash/function spellings.
Selector lists, strict negation, attribute matchers and nth formulas ignore comment payload punctuation; quoted attribute data remains literal.
The stylesheet walk retains raw selector boundaries and skips comment payload during structural scanning. Declaration/value and finite media-condition normalization retain their existing behavior.

Raw query/stylesheet admission remains in force. Existing selector spelling allowances count one virtual comment separator and preserve outer trimming; large payloads do not create a smaller effective selector limit.
Commented structural pseudo-class introductions prepay raw-source work/storage. Ordinary class/ID/attribute selectors retain their existing accounting.

source_observations.family: CSS syntax, tokenization, parsing and error recovery
implemented_slice: Hand-written comment stripping, quote/brace-aware rule walking, semicolon-aware declaration scanning, first-colon splitting and trailing !important extraction feed the shared stylesheet and inline paths.
Unknown at-rule blocks are kept opaque by the walker; invalid/unsupported selector list syntax rejects the entire style rule. Malformed declarations without a colon are skipped.

External/inline style-block admission checks whole-sheet bytes, total document bytes, block count and per-block declaration count before publishing a sheet; parser rollback removes newly added rules on budget/allocation refusal.
remaining: No general CSS Syntax token stream or component-value AST; preprocessing, escapes/identifiers, bad-string/bad-url recovery, CDO/CDC handling and exact recovery points need a normative implementation.

without_comments inserts a space for every comment. Source-derived review case: a/**/.x becomes a .x before selector parsing, changing a compound into a descendant; this audit did not execute the case.

Declaration names are raw lowercase strings (except case-sensitive custom names), not decoded CSS identifiers. Generic declarations are retained without an exhaustive recognized-property/value grammar.

Whitespace rules vary between trim(), is_ascii_whitespace(), trim_ascii() and exact CSS whitespace helpers. Group closure in DeclarationItems uses one saturating depth, not typed matching delimiters; its complete() check is used by raw script mutation but not parse_declarations_inner.
Names over 64 bytes and values over 2048 bytes are silently skipped. Inline style computation uses only a 16384-byte prefix; these are separate from atomic whole-sheet refusal.

source_observations.family: Selector grammar, matching and document semantics
implemented_slice: Type/universal, ID, class, attribute presence and =/~=/|=/^=/$=/*= with i/s flags; descendant/child/adjacent/general sibling combinators; strict comma lists.
:not() accepts bounded complex selector lists and adds maximum argument specificity; :root, :checked, :disabled, :hover, :focus and :focus-within have real topology/native-state consumers.
Eleven structural predicates implement first/last/only child/of-type, empty and nth variants. Nth coefficients use exact signed decimal arithmetic, not machine-integer truncation.

Type matching uses expanded names and HTML-document case rules; ID/class/attribute values can compare authoritative UTF-16 records rather than replacement-character projections. Sibling counting excludes non-elements and distinguishes namespaces for of-type.
remaining: CSS escapes and namespace prefixes are not parsed. Attribute names are always lowercased in parse_attribute, and its HTML insensitive-value table is selected without a document-language/namespace parameter; XML/foreign-name cases require a dedicated audit/fix.
:is(), :where(), :has(), :scope, :lang(), :dir(), link/visited/any-link, active/focus-visible/target, enabled/indeterminate and other UI/state pseudos have no shared-parser branch.
No nth-child(... of <selector-list>) or relative-selector grammar; DOM queries reject pseudo-element selectors with an error.

Limits: 512 bytes per selector, 16 list alternatives, 12 compound selectors, 8 nested functional levels, and 128 ancestor candidates for a descendant step. The last cutoff silently yields no match even when remaining work exists.

implemented_slice: Connected physical tree preorder drives inheritance and sheet order. Applicable author declarations are sorted by important, inline flag, selector specificity, sheet rule order and declaration order.
Hard-coded user-agent defaults and finite HTML presentation hints are applied before author declarations; inline important and stylesheet important ordering are real.
Position, transform, opacity and several newer consumers support finite revert/revert-layer behavior. Inline revert-layer can roll back element-attached declarations to a stylesheet checkpoint.
remaining: No shared origin/layer/encapsulation/scope ordering model, user stylesheets, animation or transition cascade origins.

CSS-wide keywords, rollback and invalid-at-computed-value behavior are spread across property-specific implementations. This makes adding origins/layers unsafe without a common winner representation.

source_observations.family: Values, units, numeric grammar and math
implemented_slice: Main HTML length parser supports px, %, em, rem, pt, pc and unitless zero; auto/negative acceptance depends on the caller.
Typed calc parser supports sums/differences of lengths, number products and division by a nonzero number, nested calc/parentheses, finite exponents and retained percentage context.
vw/vh and typed calc reach width/height/min/max, flex-basis, physical margin/padding and gaps. Viewport units use the real CSS viewport environment; relative fonts and percentages resolve later.
remaining: No shared complete Values and Units grammar. Absolute in/cm/mm/q are absent from the main HTML parser even though SVG geometry has a separate broader unit list; ch/ex/cap/ic/lh/rlh, vmin/vmax, logical/dynamic/small/large viewport and container units need work.
min/max/clamp and wider mathematical functions are not computed by sizing_math. Transform/opacity can recognize some math functions as unsupported, which is not math evaluation.
Math is not universal: top/inset, border widths and font-size use different literal parsers; tests explicitly retain earlier literals for calculated values in these consumers.

Main length numbers clamp to +/-10000 and used resolutions clamp to +/-100000; font/line-height ranges have other finite policies. Resource/implementation-range behavior needs explicit standards qualification.
attr(), env(), typed substitutions, dimensional algebra outside this finite length-percentage model and registered properties are absent from this path.

Dynamic application updates geometry before load callbacks; current charset/document environment is read when an owned response completes. Local initial sheets and HTTP(S) resources use existing loader paths.

Loader initial and dynamic type/disabled/media/mime behavior is not one unified association algorithm; integrate completed HTML semantics before adding more CSS resource modes.

source_observations.family: Font-face rule discovery and descriptor integration
implemented_slice: Top-level @font-face extraction reuses complete-sheet admission and finite declaration parsing; accepts one family, one numeric weight, normal/italic/oblique style, only normal/100% stretch, source alternatives and unicode-range.

source_observations.family: Invalidation, parse caches, candidate matching and budgets
implemented_slice: Immutable stylesheet syntax cache keys ordered owner IDs plus exact source bytes, limits, scripting state and media environment. Cache hits reuse rules while rematching DOM/native state/inline declarations/variables.

Conservative rightmost class/ID bucket indexing reduces candidates but always runs the full matcher; collisions broaden candidates only. Raw UTF-16 attributes and large keys fall back to full matching.

Geometry invalidation clears boxes and computed snapshots but preserves reusable stylesheet syntax; source/image/viewport changes invalidate. Computed reads use budgeted actual cascade and publish snapshots only after successful computation.
Work, copied bytes, retained allocation, cancellation/deadline and complete-source allowances are explicit throughout major paths; tests contain refusal and recovery controls.
remaining: No selector/variable/property/layout dependency invalidation graph; broad recascade is the current architecture. Relational selectors, containers and scope will require new dependencies and cycle/order rules.
Media environment is part of parsed-cache identity, so viewport changes reparse active-rule selection; a persistent structured rule tree could retain syntax and reevaluate conditions separately.

Not every limit is an atomic refusal: selector/identifier/value limits can silently discard syntax; 128 ancestor cutoff changes matching; MAX_MATCH_STEPS marks snapshots incomplete but can leave a returned Style vector with partial/default results.
Performance and cancellation behavior were only source-inspected; no benchmark/native execution performed.

Test stylesheet edits, ancestor/class/id/attribute changes, subtree attach/detach/reparent, native state, font/image arrivals, viewport/preferences and container/scoped/relational dependencies.
Publish no partially rebuilt caches or fake successful computed values on exhaustion/cancellation; recover with fresh capacity while retaining the previous coherent state.
Measure cold parsing, hot stylesheet reuse, local mutation and worst-case selectors/variables against pinned source/fixture hashes; keep old App logs explicitly historical.

source_observations.family: Box generation and ordinary block/inline flow
implemented_slice: Actual connected DOM traversal creates retained boxes, inline atoms, text runs, decorations, native controls, images, links and anchors. Block, inline, inline-block, inline-flex, flex, grid and finite table display categories have layout consumers.

Inline-block shrink-to-fit and baseline participation, explicit dimensions, physical margin/padding/border, text alignment and display:none suppression are implemented. Hidden INPUT is independently suppressed even if author display requests a box.
Comment/PI and other nonrendered nodes do not contribute visible flow. Browser default HTML presentation and selected legacy alignment hints already affect real layout.
remaining: General CSS Display outer/inner model, multi-keyword values, flow-root, contents, inline-grid, table captions/columns, run-in where applicable, anonymous-box fixup and block-in-inline splitting need explicit requirements.
Layout still traverses DOM nodes directly with a small formatting-context enum; a complete reusable box/fragment representation and multi-fragment element geometry are not established.
Namespace-sensitive default rendering, quirks/limited-quirks consumers, shadow/flat-tree layout and fully rendered child browsing contexts depend on the completed document foundation.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Display keywords accepted or aliased in css.rs are not proof of the complete CSS Display box-generation algorithm.
finite_limits: MAX_RUNS=100000; MAX_ITEMS=250000; MAX_DEPTH=128; walk stops at 40000 visits; MAX_HEIGHT=1000000 and MAX_WIDTH=32768 (src/layout.rs:16-23,2022).
acceptance_targets: Compare HTML and XHTML documents with the same namespace-correct tree; exercise anonymous blocks, mixed inline/block descendants, empty boxes, display changes and DOM moves.
For each case verify box/fragment structure, measured geometry, pixels, hit ownership, text/source order and post-mutation invalidation; include mode-specific expectations.

source_observations.family: Floats, clearance, block formatting contexts and margin collapsing
implemented_slice: Ordinary blocks and isolated atomic/flex/grid contexts already have finite flow behavior, and physical margins are consumed.
In inspected block() the next block position directly adds top margin and the previous block stores bottom margin into flow.y; no margin-collapse set algorithm was found.
remaining: No float/clear style state or exclusion-placement consumer was found in the inspected CSS/layout modules; flow-root is not accepted by display_value.
Implement float positioning/avoidance, clearance, BFC creation/containment, adjoining positive and negative margin collapse, empty blocks, parent/child collapse, min-height and overflow interactions.
Normal-flow and intrinsic sizes must use the same float exclusion geometry; do not approximate floats by flex or positioning.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Status concerns the named algorithms, not the existence of block or inline-block layout. Absence is based on the inspected Style/display grammar and layout consumers.
acceptance_targets: Required CSS2/CSS Display float, clear and margin-collapse tests including nested BFCs, zero-height blocks, negative margins, replaced floats, shrink-to-fit and line wrapping around floats.
Confirm margin collapse never crosses flex/grid/table-item boundaries where forbidden; resized text and DOM moves recompute exclusions and affected hits.

source_observations.family: Box sizing, intrinsic dimensions and replaced content
implemented_slice: Finite width/height/min/max, content-box/border-box, physical edges, auto margins, percentage constraints, intrinsic preferred/minimum widths and shrink-to-fit reach actual layout.
Typed calc sums/subtraction, number multiplication/division and nested parentheses support px/pt/pc/em/rem/% and captured vw/vh in selected sizing, flex, gap and spacing consumers.
Images, canvas, inline SVG, finite video and image inputs use natural dimensions/ratio, HTML hints and CSS constraints. object-fit/object-position and image-rendering reach software resampling.
Fractional flex main sizes are retained during line collection before final pixel distribution; current ordinary layout stores integer surface pixels.
remaining: Complete intrinsic sizing contribution rules, min-content/max-content/fit-content/stretch grammar, aspect-ratio, replaced auto-size rules, orthogonal flows and cyclic percentage handling remain required.
Complete unit/math families, logical dimensions and indefinite/definite containing-block propagation are not established by the existing finite typed-length grammar.
Define subpixel layout and API rounding consistently across ordinary flow, tables, flex, grid, zoom and transforms; current caps need explicit host-policy behavior and test coverage.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: A value parsed by calc or available through CSSOM is supported only in each specific property and used-value context that actually consumes it.
finite_limits: Length resolution clamps to +/-100000; ordinary used geometry has independent width/height caps. build_viewport clamps width/height to 16384, zoom to 0.25-5.0.
acceptance_targets: Exact geometry tests for intrinsic contributions and explicit/auto/min/max/aspect-ratio combinations, percentage cycles, border-box edges and nested definite heights.
Use original deterministic fonts/images and multiple zoom/viewport values; compare geometry and pixels separately, then mutate resource sizes or styles and verify current hits/selection.

source_observations.family: Positioning and containing blocks
implemented_slice: Relative offsets move retained spans without altering normal flow. Absolute/fixed elements are queued out of flow and use measured containing blocks, physical insets, percentage dimensions and auto margins.
Finite shrink-to-fit absolute captions, replaced positioned dimensions and transformed-ancestor containing blocks are real. Viewport-fixed content tracks root scrolling without growing document flow.
Raw offset geometry is retained separately from later visual translation and source-order paint placement.
remaining: Sticky is explicitly a computed keyword with no scroll-dependent clamping; it requires actual scrollport, containing-block and inset geometry.
Complete static-position, fragmented inline containing blocks, logical insets/RTL overconstraint, replaced/orthogonal positioned layout and fragmented/page-fixed rules remain required.
Anchor positioning, top-layer/dialog/popover integration and newer positioning modules require separate normative inventory rather than inference from absolute positioning.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: src/css.rs Position::Sticky comment is explicit: computed sticky support is not sticky layout support.
finite_limits: At most 2048 queued positioned nodes; MAX_DEPTH=128.
acceptance_targets: Pin relative/absolute/fixed/sticky requirements separately. Test nearest containing blocks, nested transforms, writing directions, auto margins, min/max and all inset pairs.
Scroll nested containers and resize/zoom while checking visual rects, raw offsets, clips, focus and native hits. Sticky must move only when its real scroll constraints demand it.

source_observations.family: Flexbox and box alignment
implemented_slice: Original flex layout supports row/row-reverse/column/column-reverse, grow/shrink/basis, iterative min/max freezing, row wrapping, gaps, auto margins, finite justify/align packing and nested stretch.
Inline-flex shrink wraps, participates as an atomic inline with a finite baseline, and blockifies in flex/grid/positioned contexts.
Final geometry moves text, controls, decorations, anchors and hits together; tests include fractional fitting, image/control constraints and reading order.
remaining: order, wrap-reverse, complete column wrapping, baseline alignment groups, safe/unsafe alignment and the complete intrinsic/automatic minimum algorithm are not established by this subset.
Anonymous flex-item grouping across text nodes, writing modes/RTL/orthogonal flows, complete replaced aspect-ratio interaction and fragmentation require explicit algorithms/tests.
Preserve existing fractional pre-rounding fitting and independent semantic order while broadening layout.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Existing flex is a genuine formatting algorithm; passing a responsive two-column fixture does not establish complete Flexbox.
finite_limits: MAX_FLEX_ITEMS=2048; shared flex-work budget=4000000; geometry caps remain.
acceptance_targets: Require complete selected Flexbox and Alignment contract cohorts: multi-line rows/columns, reversals, order, baseline, intrinsic sizing, auto minima and cyclic percentages.
Reuse existing end-to-end editor/link/anchor tests and add resize/font-load/DOM-reorder cases with fragment geometry and overflow, without changing semantic reading order.

source_observations.family: Grid layout and alignment
implemented_slice: Default grid is a real single implicit column: successive in-flow rows, row gaps, anonymous adjacent text grouping, min-content column widening, definite-height track stretch, item constraints and alignment.
justify-items/justify-self start/center/end/stretch and auto margins move actual boxes, paint, overflow clips and hit regions.
Grid work/copy admission and incomplete-state tracking withhold affected geometry rather than advertising guessed completed tracks.
remaining: No authored track definitions or general placement state appears in Style: grid-template, explicit lines/areas, spans, auto-flow/dense placement, fr/minmax/repeat and complete track-sizing algorithms remain.
Inline-grid, subgrid, intrinsic contributions, baseline alignment, RTL/writing modes and grid fragmentation are distinct open contracts.
Existing one-column fixture and later alignment fixture are separate evidence, not a claim of general Grid support.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: display:grid is not merely treated as block: a real finite grid exists. Its single-column scope must remain explicit.
finite_limits: Uses MAX_FLEX_ITEMS=2048 and shared layout work; GridBudget meters work/copies when a CssBudget is supplied.
acceptance_targets: Progress from explicit/implicit tracks and placement to intrinsic/flexible track sizing, percentages and auto-repeat, then subgrid and fragmentation according to the approved normative register.
For each track case inspect final track/line coordinates, content contribution, overflow, pixels and hits; preserve budget refusal/recovery and unavailable geometry on incomplete layout.

source_observations.family: CSS tables and legacy table integration
implemented_slice: Separate-border tables share nonspanning column widths using intrinsic minimum/preferred sizes and percentage hints. Row/cell layout paints once per cell, stretches cell decoration and preserves controls/hits.
Row groups, row client extents, border-spacing and HTML valign/align presentation are consumed. Some finite CSS display aliases are retained for readback.
remaining: Source explicitly excludes span resolution, collapsed borders and anonymous table-object repair.

Complete table wrappers/captions/columns, fixed/auto algorithms, rowspan/colspan constraints, baseline/vertical-align, empty-cell handling, border-conflict resolution and fragmented repeated headers/footers remain.
HTML table-tree construction progress is separate from the CSS table formatting algorithm; namespace and mode consumers must be tested after foundation completion.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: HTML valign is consumed directly; this does not establish general CSS vertical-align support.
finite_limits: table_rows stops after 8192 visits, 2048 rows/cells; a row collects at most 128 cells.
acceptance_targets: Pin separate and collapsed border models, span/caption/column and fixed/auto sizing cohorts with deterministic fonts and exact geometry.
Combine malformed HTML recovery and valid XHTML tables with the same formatting expectations where trees match; mutate spans/styles and verify controls/hits, scroll extents and print fragmentation.

Test actual native print/preview lifecycle and paged artifacts separately from software raster references, including font/image load completion and cancellation.

source_observations.family: Inline layout, line breaking and CSS text decoration
implemented_slice: Actual line layout collapses ASCII whitespace or preserves pre/pre-wrap, wraps words and then character segments, uses font metrics/line-height, supports left/center/right alignment and maintains text-stream separators.
Glyph advances, caret boundaries, source search/selection and paint use shared finite proportional metrics. Atomic inline baselines and underline/bold/italic rendering are present.
break-spaces is currently mapped to the same internal WhiteSpace::PreWrap value.
remaining: CSS Text white-space phases and values must be implemented distinctly, with Unicode line-break opportunities, word-break/overflow-wrap/hyphens, language-sensitive rules, line-break, tab-size, spacing and justification.
Complete inline formatting boxes/struts, line-height and vertical-align, decoration propagation/styles/thickness/skip-ink, text-transform, indent, text-overflow and ruby need explicit contracts.
Current character splitting cannot establish grapheme-safe line breaks or complex-script behavior; integrate the original Unicode/shaping result instead of adding separate width approximations.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: The function name shape() describes per-character glyph placement in this source; it does not mean Unicode/OpenType complex shaping is implemented.
acceptance_targets: Whitespace matrices across text-node/inline boundaries, CR/LF/tab, NBSP, preserved trailing spaces, language/script samples, oversized words and empty lines.
Assert line/fragment/cluster boundaries and baseline metrics, then selection/caret/search/copy/pixels after font load, resize and DOM mutation.

source_observations.family: CSS fonts, loading, matching and original rasterization
implemented_slice: Original TrueType outline parsing, quadratic/composite glyphs, cmap lookup, legacy kern, metrics, grayscale coverage rasterization and WOFF1 reconstruction are real.

Font family order, weight/style, per-character fallback, unicode-range and bounded @font-face local/URL alternatives are implemented. Known system font files are input data, parsed and rasterized by original code.

Initial font-use planning uses actual computed families and selected character ranges, stylesheet final base URLs, same-origin/CSP/local-root policy and source caching. Native text/input tests use actual proportional glyphs.
remaining: WOFF2/Brotli, CFF outlines, variable fonts and collections are explicitly rejected. Full font matching/features/variations/metrics override descriptors and required font synthesis rules remain.
Conditional/dynamic/resize-triggered face fetching, font-display/loading timing, CSS Font Loading interfaces and general cross-origin font CORS are not established by initial top-level loading.
Expand formats/shaping with original implementations and official licensed data/fixtures; do not add platform text/codec or third-party shaping fallback.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: System font files are data, not OS text-rendering fallback. Font decoder support, CSS matching and shaping are separate acceptance dimensions.
finite_limits: 16 MiB per font; 24 web faces; glyph cache 4 MiB/1024 glyphs; raster size <=512; outline/contour/component/depth/scan caps (font.rs:8-15). CSS font size is clamped to 1-256px.
acceptance_targets: Pin each supported font format/profile and CSS Fonts/Font Loading contract; verify checksums, corrupt input, resource limit/recovery and alternate source ordering.

Exercise late loads, fallback swaps, unicode ranges, variation/features and font failure through line reflow, intrinsic sizes, computed values, selection and native controls; test HTTP origin/CSP/cancellation independently.

source_observations.family: Complex text shaping, clusters and script support
implemented_slice: Current FontSpec::shape selects one glyph per Rust char using cmap, applies legacy pair kerning and synthetic bold/italic, and stores monotonic per-character positions.
remaining: No GSUB/GPOS shaping, script/language itemization, combining-mark positioning, ligature cluster map, grapheme-safe selection or context shaping was found in the inspected text/font path.

Implement original shaping and Unicode segmentation with explicit text-unit/cluster/caret contracts. Sharing metrics among current consumers is valuable but cannot substitute for correct glyph clusters.
Fallback must preserve cluster/script shaping where required; invalid/unsupported glyphs need deterministic fallback and resource admission without corrupting adjacent text.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Status concerns complex shaping; proportional Latin text, glyph rasterization and kerning are implemented. Unicode/OpenType normative inputs must be added to the final dependency register beyond W3C CSS references.
acceptance_targets: Original fonts covering Arabic joining, Indic reordering, combining marks, ligatures, emoji/variation sequences and mixed-script fallback; official licensed shaping/Unicode fixtures where authorized.
Assert glyph IDs/advances/offsets and cluster maps, then real caret, selection/copy, line breaking, hit testing and measured/painted equality across mutations.

source_observations.family: Writing modes, bidi and logical properties
implemented_slice: The positioned-layout source explicitly identifies the engine as horizontal left-to-right. Internal margins/insets/widths/gaps and line progression are predominantly physical axes.
remaining: No CSS writing-mode, direction/unicode-bidi layout state or logical-property mapping consumer was found in the inspected Style/layout modules.
Implement the Unicode bidi algorithm and CSS bidi isolation/embedding/reordering, horizontal/vertical/sideways writing, orientation, orthogonal flows and logical properties/values.
Adapt baselines, containing blocks, alignment, scroll origins, text-selection order and geometry APIs to axis/direction semantics; do not infer them from reversed flex order.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: HTML dir/lang reflection or metadata is not bidi or writing-mode layout.
acceptance_targets: RTL/mixed-direction paragraphs and isolates with stable logical DOM text, vertical writing and orthogonal nested boxes, combined with flex/grid/table/positioned layout.
Verify visual versus logical navigation, selections, CSSOM rects, native hits and negative/reverse scroll origin semantics.

source_observations.family: Lists, counters, generated content and pseudo-element boxes
implemented_slice: HTML ul/ol/li are traversed with a finite list counter; ol start and li value are consumed. Decimal/none and grouped disc/circle/square classification exist; the current disc marker is painted as a hyphen.
List marker text reaches real TextRun geometry and painting.
remaining: General ::before/::after/::marker generated boxes, content/counters/counter-reset/increment/set, counter styles, quotes, marker positioning and images remain.
Pseudo-element selector recognition must not create a support claim without generated box ownership, inheritance, painting, selection/accessibility and lifecycle semantics.
Pagination counters and target/content functions depend on relevant selected modules and fragment/page lifecycle.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Finite HTML list labels are real paint but do not establish the CSS counter/generated-content model.
acceptance_targets: Counter scopes across nested/reordered/display-none nodes, pseudo content inheritance/replacement and marker geometry, with dynamic updates and no fabricated DOM nodes.
Distinguish supported HTML default list presentation from authored CSS Lists/Generated Content/Counter Styles contracts.

source_observations.family: CSS color values and color processing
implemented_slice: Foreground/background/border colors, currentColor, inheritance/variables and finite named/hex/rgb forms reach actual paint. Border alpha has a separate real blending consumer.

A richer straight-sRGB RGBA parser exists for supported shared solid-color/Canvas consumers, including short/long alpha hex and functional rgb/rgba. Opaque-only HTML background handling explicitly rejects partial alpha.
User dark-page/link-color preferences are applied to painting separately from script-visible styles.
remaining: Complete interoperable color grammar and names, consistent alpha across all consumers, hsl/hwb/lab/lch/oklab/oklch/color(), relative colors/color-mix and required system colors remain.
Color interpolation spaces, premultiplication, compositing, output color management/gamut and forced-color policies need explicit contracts; advanced image/color format handling is separate.
Do not credit Canvas color parsing as HTML foreground/background support when the styles and painter still store/consume opaque RGB.

test_source_anchors.symbol: shared solid parser versus opaque background assertion

source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Color parsing, computed color and actual alpha/color-space paint are separate gates.
acceptance_targets: Parser/computed serialization and independent numeric/pixel reference tests per color consumer, including alpha=0/1, partially transparent boundaries and currentColor inheritance.
Test native preferences without leaking visited state or altering author CSSOM improperly; pin color-space/output assumptions in raster evidence.

source_observations.family: Background images, layers and canvas propagation
implemented_slice: One URL background layer is genuinely loaded, cascaded, laid out and painted on supported ordinary boxes with winning stylesheet owner/base provenance.

Repeat/no-repeat/repeat-x/repeat-y, finite positions, auto/contain/cover size, padding-box origin, border-box image clipping, visibility-independent resource retention, resizing and stale-resource rejection exist.
Color-only background shorthand resets finite longhands. Root/body color propagation and color background-clip border/padding/content-box have real finite consumers.
remaining: Multiple layers, complete shorthand, explicit background-size lengths, attachment/origin semantics, root canvas image propagation, gradients/image-set and animated background playback remain.
Inline-fragment and replaced-element decoration, row-only decoration, text/image clip and full elliptical inner-corner clipping are outside the current slice.
Preserve resource-owner/base correctness through imports, cascade layers, dynamic rules and future resource combinations.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: background-clip currently clips the supported color path; recognizing text or multilayer clip values as unsupported winners is not implementing them.
acceptance_targets: Layer order/origin/clip/attachment and repeat geometry with asymmetric transparent images, scroll/zoom, root/body propagation and fragmented inline boxes.
Exercise real redirected resource requests, cancellation/replacement, image preference/CSP/origin refusal and load timing alongside exact expected pixels and unchanged content dimensions.

source_observations.family: Borders, corners and background clipping
implemented_slice: Physical solid/none/hidden borders, individual widths/colors, shorthand handling and border alpha paint are implemented with corner overdraw controls.

Circular equal absolute radius can round ordinary color-backed block/flex/grid/inline-block boxes; uniform solid borders are integrated with the rounded paint. Padding/content color clips have finite used-inset handling.
Unsupported percentage/elliptical/unequal winning radii are retained as unavailable instead of resurrecting an earlier supported circle.
remaining: Complete border styles, individual elliptical radii/percentages, overlap normalization, mixed-width/color corners, rounded image clipping, inline box-decoration behavior and outlines remain.
Border-image source/slice/width/outset/repeat and shadow effects need their own geometry/resource/pixel contracts.
Current radius restriction is a paint limitation even where per-corner cascade slots accept values.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Per-corner cascade precedence is implemented; only equal circular absolute used radii have the audited rounding consumer.
acceptance_targets: Independent coverage references for asymmetric/translucent corners, collapsed inner radius, clipping and fractional zoom; box and hit geometry must remain consistent.
Complete shorthand/reset/inheritance/unsupported-winner tests followed by actual final-size paint after flex/grid resizing and DOM/style changes.

source_observations.family: CSS gradients, shadows and border images
implemented_slice: Image sampling and original SVG local gradients provide reusable primitives, but no general HTML CSS gradient/shadow/border-image consumer was found in the inspected Style/paint path.
remaining: Implement CSS linear/radial/conic/repeating gradients, stops/hints/interpolation and sizing; box-shadow/text-shadow spread/blur/inset/lists; border-image nine-slice geometry and repetition.
Effects need expanded ink bounds, clipping, stacking and finite allocation/work policy. SVG local gradients must not be counted as CSS Images gradient support.
source_observations.pipeline_qualification: Absence scoped to ordinary CSS/HTML rendering; static SVG gradients are a separate existing capability.
acceptance_targets: Independent gradient sampling and shadow coverage references, exact edge/transparent behavior, interpolation spaces, overflow/clip/hit distinctions and bounded extreme extents.

source_observations.family: CSS transforms
implemented_slice: Finite translate/translateX/translateY and supported zero-z translate3d reach retained paint/hits/clips and fractional visual border rectangles; raw offset boxes remain unchanged.
Identity translation still establishes the supported containing/stacking context. Nested translations and transformed fixed descendants use actual ancestor behavior.
Parser recognizes some nontranslation functions as syntactically valid but unsupported; geometry/readback can remain explicitly unavailable.
remaining: General 2D matrices/scale/rotate/skew, origin/transform-box, independent transform properties, transform lists/interpolation, 3D perspective/preserve-3d/backface and transformed overflow remain.
